title: 突起付き注意喚起舗装板
description: 36個の切頭突起を備える単体の注意喚起舗装板。アクセシビリティ規格への適合は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A single practical warning paving slab with 36 truncated tactile domes. Accessibility-standard compliance has not been validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
